description: GDP and GVA by industry, % y/y and Rs crore, constant and current prices, as published by MoSPI (National Accounts Statistics): quarterly on the 2022-23 base from Apr–Jun 2022; annual on the 2011-12 base to 2022-23 and the 2022-23 base from 2023-24 (latest estimate of each year). Also services (tertiary sector) growth, calculated (calculated = y): sum of the levels of trade, hotels, transport, communication and broadcasting; financial, real estate and professional services; public administration, defence and other services. And manufacturing share at current prices, annual, on each base: % of GVA (measure share) and % of GDP (share_gdp), calculated. Also growth on the 2011-12 base for all its published years, as published: GDP, real and nominal (code gdp_2011base) and manufacturing GVA, real and nominal (code manufacturing_2011base). Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/gdp/in_gdp.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each quarterly GDP release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
title: India GDP and GVA (MoSPI)
